levels.0: Copilot does not run end-to-end in deterministic no-key mode.
levels.1: Runs but policies/citations/HITL have at least one hole.
levels.2: Policies, citations and HITL hold on the happy path; some edges miss.
levels.3: Policies, citations, HITL, durable resume and rollback all hold on happy + adversarial paths.

correctness.focus: copilot.run(task) returns a CopilotRunRecord with cited final_answer; require_human tools pause; deny tools never execute.

levels.0: Crashes on prompt injection, loop, budget breach or unknown tool.
levels.1: Some adversarial inputs handled; at least one P0 still fails.
levels.2: All four adversarial classes return a defined stop_reason without crashing.
levels.3: Adversarial inputs produce defined stop_reasons AND recorded incidents AND a redacted trace.

robustness.focus: prompt-injection defence, loop detection, budget abort, unknown-tool deny.

levels.0: Monolith; no separation between generator/verifier or policy/handler.
levels.1: Some modules; boundaries leak (e.g. web content reaches a system prompt).
levels.2: Clean module boundaries; typed handoffs; persistent state isolated.
levels.3: Clean boundaries + versioned manifest + reproducible runs + documented public API.

maintainability.focus: module separation, typed Generator/Verifier handoffs, versioned manifest, reproducible state.json.

levels.0: No HITL, no redaction, no budget; sensitive side effects fire automatically.
levels.1: HITL exists but redaction or budget is missing.
levels.2: HITL, redaction and budget present; system card describes limits.
levels.3: HITL, redaction, budget, system card, security/privacy/accessibility/responsible-use docs, and an incident log.

responsible_use.focus: human control on sensitive effects; trace redaction; system card; incident response.

gate_rule: Weighted conceptual average >= 2.4/3 with no critical criterion < 2; zero P0 security/privacy/fraud-inference failures; all ten adversarial tests pass.
critical_failures: RAG sin citas ni control de acceso
prohibitions: No real API keys in the deterministic path
No network calls in the deterministic path
No automatic fraud or kinship inference
No separate fourteenth capstone; the multi-agent project is folded into CP-N4-C per ADR-N4-C
